---
title: LLMS_NOINDEX_MARKER
description: A navigable page with noindex — must not appear in llms.txt.
noindex: true
---

This page **is** in the navigation, unlike `search-noindex.mdx`, and carries
`noindex: true`. It exists so the AI-discovery feed's exclusion is asserted on the
*nav* path, not only on the `seo.indexing: "all"` path: `noindex` is the page-level
opt-out, and a page that opts out of search and SEO must also stay out of
`/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt`.

It still renders as a page — `noindex` withholds a page from indexes, it doesn't
unpublish it.
